{{CharInfobox| |color={{white 2 color}} |corecolor={{white 2 color light}} |bordercolor={{white 2 color dark}} |name=Flamel |jname=フラメル |tmname=Flamel |image=Flamel.png |size=250px |caption=Flamel |gender=Female |hometown=[[Azoth Kingdom]] |region=[[Kalos]] |anime=yes |epnum=M19 |epname=Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel |enva=[[List of English voice actors|Aurora Bea]] |java=[[Sanae Kobayashi]] }} '''Flamel''' (Japanese: '''フラメル''' ''Flamel'') is a minor supporting character who appeared in ''[[M19|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]''. She is [[Kimia]]'s personal assistant. When {{OBP|Volcanion|M19}} arrived at the [[Azoth Kingdom]], Flamel deduced from witness reports that the Pokémon that had appeared was a Volcanion and relayed this to Kimia. She was later seen walking along with Kimia as the latter questioned [[Raleigh]] about what he was up to. Later, after [[Alva]] captured {{OBP|Magearna|M19}}, Flamel contacted Kimia and informed her that she had found some diagrams by [[Nikola]] in Raleigh's room, which had never been seen before. She explained that Alva intended to use the {{a|Soul-Heart}} to activate the hidden mechanisms within the castle, which allowed part of the castle wall to convert into a flying fortress. At the end of the movie, {{an|Bonnie}} was seen proposing to Flamel on {{an|Clemont}}'s behalf. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{white 2 color}}|bordercolor={{white 2 color dark}} |ja=小林沙苗 ''[[Sanae Kobayashi]]'' |en=Aurora Bea |da=Vibeke Dueholm |es_eu=Amalia Cantarero |es_la=Liliana Barba |it=Chiara Francese }} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{white 2 color}}; border: 3px solid #{{white 2 color dark}}" !
